notes: THREE FIXES FROM THE FIELD, reported by the finance office and closed the same day. THE RECEIPT BUTTON WORKS AGAIN. Since v0.6.59, pressing Receipt on a posted fund receipt opened an invisible card — a collision between the receipt layout and the printed-documents system. The official receipt now appears on screen so you can check the payer and the amount before printing, and printing produces the receipt alone, not the working screen behind it. THE RECONCILIATION NOW SAYS WHERE CREDITING HAPPENS. Uncredited lodgements sat listed with no way forward. The list now tells you: when the bank statement shows one, mark it CREDITED in the Cheque & Lodgement Register (Lodgements tab) — or import the statement and let the amounts match. AN INTERRUPTED FUEL PURCHASE CAN BE FINISHED. If recording a coupon purchase failed partway, the money reached the fuel-stock account but the coupons never reached the register — and re-entering the invoice would have paid the bank twice. The Fuel Coupons screen now flags exactly that, naming the voucher and the amount, with a FINISH RECORDING button that completes the original purchase without touching the bank again. The screen also checks, continuously, that the coupon register agrees with the fuel-stock account — and says so when it cannot check. If your ledger currently holds a fuel purchase the coupon stock is missing, open Fuel Coupons after upgrading: the alert and the button will be waiting. There is NO database change: your data and settings are untouched, and the upgrade is simply installing over the old version.
